# The Changing Face of America: Sarasota County, Florida
An interactive demographic exploration of **Sarasota County, Florida** using official **2020–2024 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-Year Estimates** (`Table B03002`) and **2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line** census tract boundaries.
:::

## Key Demographic Snapshot (2024 ACS 5-Year)

:::: {.kpi-grid}
::: {.kpi-card}
<div class="kpi-label">Total Population</div>
<div class="kpi-value">`r comma(sarasota_summary$total_pop)`</div>
<div class="kpi-sub">Across `r sarasota_summary$n_tracts` land census tracts</div>
:::

::: {.kpi-card .coral}
<div class="kpi-label">Hispanic or Latino</div>
<div class="kpi-value">`r sprintf("%.1f%%", sarasota_summary$hispanic_pct)`</div>
<div class="kpi-sub">`r comma(sarasota_summary$hispanic_pop)` residents (of any race)</div>
:::

::: {.kpi-card .teal}
<div class="kpi-label">Racial & Ethnic Minorities</div>
<div class="kpi-value">`r sprintf("%.1f%%", sarasota_summary$bipoc_pct)`</div>
<div class="kpi-sub">`r comma(sarasota_summary$bipoc_pop)` Hispanic & Non-White residents</div>
:::

::: {.kpi-card .amber}
<div class="kpi-label">Highest Hispanic Tract</div>
<div class="kpi-value">`r sprintf("%.1f%%", sarasota_summary$max_hispanic_tract$pct_hispanic)`</div>
<div class="kpi-sub">`r sarasota_summary$max_hispanic_tract$tract_label` (`r comma(sarasota_summary$max_hispanic_tract$hispanicE)` residents)</div>
:::
::::

## Interactive Census Tract Map Preview

Hover over or click any census tract in Sarasota County to inspect its **Hispanic or Latino share**, total population, and full mutually exclusive racial/ethnic profile. Visit the [Interactive Map](map.qmd) page for a larger view and neighborhood-level comparisons.

::: {.viz-card}
```{r}
build_hispanic_map()
```
:::

## County-Wide Racial & Ethnic Composition

All categories below come from **U.S. Census Bureau Table B03002** (*Hispanic or Latino Origin by Race*), ensuring that Hispanic/Latino residents and Non-Hispanic racial categories are **strictly mutually exclusive** and sum to **100.0%** of Sarasota County's population. See the [Demographics](demographics.qmd) page for detailed breakdowns.

::: {.viz-card}
```{r}
build_race_ethnicity_bar()
```
:::
